args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. The site has a clean and simple design, which makes it easy to navigate. I'd suggest adding a bit more content about yourself — for example, your background, interests, projects, or skills — to give visitors a better sense of who you are. Including some visuals or a portfolio section could also make it more engaging. Overall, it's a great start, and with a few enhancements it could really shine!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that your blog is centered around hiking — it's a wonderful hobby, and it gives your site a clear focus. I'd suggest adding more posts about your hiking experiences, favorite trails, gear recommendations, or tips for beginners, as that kind of content would be really valuable to readers. Adding some photos from your hikes would also make the blog much more engaging. Keep up the great work!
